# OWNERSHIP.md — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** project root (`/OWNERSHIP.md`). Tier 0.
> **Purpose:** determines who may write which files. Without this, two agents running
> in parallel will overwrite each other's work, and all you see is strange merge conflicts
> or — worse — changes that disappear silently.

**Single rule:** one path, one owner. An agent that is not the owner may **read**
anything, but must not write. If a change is needed in another agent's territory, submit
it as a task to the orchestrator — do not edit directly.

---

## Ownership matrix

| Agent / role | May write | Read only | Must not touch |
|---|---|---|---|
| **orchestrator** | `docs/dev-docs/TASKS.md`, task graph | all | `src/**` |
| **ba-spec** | `acceptance/**`, AC in `docs/planning/FSD.md` | PRD, SCOPE-STATEMENT | `src/**` |
| **ui-ux** | `contracts/tokens.json`, `docs/design/**` | BRAND, FSD | `src/**` |
| **api-designer** | `contracts/openapi.yaml`, `contracts/errors.catalog.json`, `docs/architecture/API-REFERENCE.md` | FSD, ERD | `src/**` |
| **data** | `contracts/schema.sql`, `{prisma/}`, `migrations/**`, `seeds/**`, `docs/database/**` | ERD, openapi | `src/app/**` |
| **backend** | `src/server/**`, `src/modules/**` | contracts/**, ARCHITECTURE | `src/app/**`, `migrations/**` |
| **frontend** | `src/app/**`, `src/components/**`, `src/styles/**` | contracts/**, tokens | `src/server/**` |
| **system-integrator** | `docs/misc/INTEGRATIONS.md`, `src/integrations/**`, `tests/mocks/**` | contracts/**, ENVIRONMENTS | `src/modules/**` |
| **qa** | `tests/**` (except `tests/mocks/`), `docs/testing/**` | all | `src/**` |
| **appsec** | `docs/security/**`, `tests/security/**` | all | `src/**` |
| **reviewer** | PR comments, `docs/dev-docs/TECHNICAL-DEBT.md` | all | all code |
| **release** | `docs/deployment/**`, release notes, deployment checklist | Deployment + release manager |

> Adjust paths to match the actual project structure (`docs/architecture/FOLDER-STRUCTURE.md`).
> If a path does not appear in this table, **no one may write it** until an owner is assigned.
> Default is deny, not allow.

---

## Tier 0 files — humans only

The following files must not be changed by any agent without explicit approval:

```
AGENTS.md
ARCHITECTURE.md
OWNERSHIP.md          ← this file
VERIFY.md
CONVENTIONS.md
docs/decisions/ADR-*.md   (agents may propose drafts, humans merge)
```

Reason: these are the rules of engagement. An agent allowed to change the rules will change
them when the rules get in the way — usually exactly when the rules are working.

---

## Contract changes = all consumers notified

When a contract owner changes a file in `contracts/`, the following tasks **must** be created
before the change is merged:

| Contract changed | Automatic task for |
|---|---|
| `contracts/openapi.yaml` | backend (implementation), frontend (client types), qa (contract test) |
| `contracts/schema.sql` | data (migration), backend (repository), qa (fixture) |
| `contracts/tokens.json` | frontend (regenerate CSS vars), ui-ux (documentation) |
| `contracts/errors.catalog.json` | backend (mapping), frontend (user-facing messages) |
| `acceptance/*.feature` | qa (test), and the owner of the affected module |

Breaking contract changes (field removed, type changed, endpoint removed) require an ADR
and a new version — not an in-place edit.

---

## Parallel work isolation

When more than one agent is active simultaneously:

```bash
# One worktree per agent — not one working directory taking turns
git worktree add ../{proj}-be  feat/{sprint}-{module}-be
git worktree add ../{proj}-fe  feat/{sprint}-{module}-fe
```

**Rules:**
- Each agent works only in its worktree, only on paths it owns.
- Contracts (`contracts/**`) are locked **before** FE and BE start. No FE/BE parallelism
  on top of contracts that are still changing — that is not parallelism, that is guessing.
- Merges to the integration branch go sequentially through a single queue, not simultaneously.
- If two agents need to write the same path, the task was split incorrectly. Re-split
  vertically (one complete feature per agent), not horizontally (one layer per agent).

---

## Violation detection (manual, at `gate:pr` — no script required)

This skill ships no executable ownership-checker. The check is done by the agent
opening a PR and recording it directly, and it is not optional — a PR from a
`multi_agent: true` project does not satisfy `gate:pr` (see `VERIFY.md`) without this
record attached to the PR/commit description:

```markdown
## Ownership Verification — {PR title}

**Author role:** {agent/role from the Ownership matrix above}
**Paths touched:** {list every file this PR changes}

| Path touched | Owning role (per matrix) | Match? |
|---|---|---|
| {path} | {role} | {yes / NO — escalate} |

**Tier 0 files touched:** {none | list — requires explicit human approval, see above}
**Result:** {clear | escalated: <reason>}
```

Fill the table by checking each touched path against this file's Ownership matrix and
Tier 0 list — a path with no matching row is **unowned = write denied** by default, not
a pass. If any row reads "NO," the PR does not merge until either the path is
reassigned to the correct owner or `OWNERSHIP.md` is updated (via a Tier-0, human-approved
change) to grant it. As a secondary net, GitHub `CODEOWNERS` with required reviewers per
directory catches anything a missed manual check would otherwise let through.
